cohort.0: The participants were 673 term/near-term neonates selected from 26,369 consecutive neonates, all experiencing extreme hyperbilirubinemia.

finding.0: A clinical prediction rule for acute bilirubin encephalopathy (ABE) was established using total serum bilirubin (TSB), bilirubin/albumin ratio (B/A), and sepsis, demonstrating good performance (AUC 0.871) in term/near-term neonates with extreme hyperbilirubinemia.
